Round 4: marriage 7 May 1746 (groom from Pittarella); 1729 baptism names a different father (Gioacchino), conflict flagged.

bio: Antonio married Anna Villella on 7 May 1746; the index notes that the groom came from Pittarella ([R4-S1]), a hamlet of Pedivigliano in the Savuto valley. A San Mango baptism of an Antonio Sacco on 26 January 1729 exists, but it names his parents as Gioacchino Sacco and Mattea Pagliuso, not the tree's Carmine Sacco ([R4-S2]). Because the groom was from Pittarella, that baptism may belong to a different Antonio.

conflicts.found: San Mango 1729 baptism of an Antonius Sacco names Joachim Sacco and Matthea Pagliuso; the groom of 1746 was from Pittarella
conflicts.assessment: Unresolved: either the tree's Carmine comes from Pittarella records, or the 1729 San Mango baptism is his and the father is Gioacchino.
